newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Stones thrown briefly at police on Temple Mount.
newsitem.headline: Stones thrown briefly at police on Temple Mount.

text.p: Stones were hurled briefly at Israeli police after Moslem Friday prayers on Jerusalem's Temple Mount but no one was hurt, witnesses said.
Police did not enter the al-Aqsa mosque complex where Moslem clerics urged about 500 protesters to disperse. Police moved Jewish worshippers from the Wailing Wall below the mosque.
Last week Israeli police shot dead three stone-throwers in Friday prayer protests against the opening of a nearby archaeological tunnel.
No stones were thrown down onto the Wailing Wall where Jews were praying during the Feast of the Tabernacles pilgrimage.
